text_explainability.description: Gradient attribution computed on DistilBERT embedding layer with respect to class logit.

visual_explainability.description: Grad-CAM computed on ResNet18 Layer4 convolutional feature maps with ReLU rectifying positive gradients.

video_explainability.temporal_pooling_evidence: Uniform temporal sampling extracted 8 individual frames through ResNet18, followed by feature-level temporal pooling (feature_mean_pooling) to construct the video representation.
video_explainability.description: 8 frames uniformly sampled, batch-forwarded through ResNet18, temporally mean-pooled, and keyframe Grad-CAM generated on frame 4.

audio_explainability.evidence_description: Acoustic feature analysis (5.0s) confirms natural vocal harmonic distribution with consistent formant continuity.
audio_explainability.description: 128-D acoustic features (STFT log-mel spectral energy + std) extracted with ZCR and high-frequency energy ratio.
